app.name: Itqan Academy
app.description: Student registration, recitation queue, and attendance tracking in one place.

newStudent.title: New student?
newStudent.body: Register once with your name and your father's name. After that you join any circle by searching for your name.

returningStudent.title: Already registered?
returningStudent.body: Open your circle's link and search for your name to join today's queue. No need to register again.
returningStudent.note: Your teacher shares the circle link with you.

register.title: Register a new student
register.subtitle: You only register once. After that you join any circle by searching for your name.

fields.name: Name
fields.fatherNameHint: Used to tell you apart from similar names.
fields.phoneHint: Only used to reach you if needed.

success.title: Registered
success.body: Welcome, {name}. Your name is now saved permanently.
success.nextStep: Open your circle's link and search for your name to join the queue.

duplicate.title: A matching name is already registered
duplicate.body: If this is you, do not register again — go back to your circle's link and search for your name.
duplicate.hint: Registering twice splits your attendance across two records.

errors.generic: Registration could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: The database is not connected yet.

circle.title: Circle
circle.notToday: This circle is not scheduled to meet today.

search.label: Search for your name
search.placeholder: Type the first two letters of your name
search.hint: At least two letters. Results show the father's name to tell similar names apart.

notFound.title: We could not find your name
notFound.body: If this is your first time, register once and then come back to this page.

joined.title: You are on the list, {name}
joined.position: You are number {position} in the queue.

queue.title: Queue ({count})
queue.empty: Nobody has joined yet. Be the first.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.genderMismatch: You cannot join a circle from a different section.

setup.title: Database not connected
setup.body: Add your Supabase project credentials, then restart the dev server.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notFoundBody: That link is incorrect or no longer available.
